title: Laplap
description: Vanuatu laplap is traditionally grated tuber and coconut cream baked in banana leaves beneath hot stones; this is a home-oven taro version.

steps.instruction: Peel edible taro, cut into chunks and boil in water until completely tender, 25–35 minutes; drain well. Never use wild taro.
Mash cooked taro thoroughly. Stir in coconut cream and salt to make a thick, spreadable mass.
Soften banana leaves with steam, then use them to line a baking dish. Spread in the taro mixture and fold leaves over the top.
Bake covered at 180°C for 35–40 minutes until steaming hot and cohesive. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
